documents.text: Francesco Negri (travel writer) Francesco Negri (; 27 March 1623–27 December 1698) was an Italian Catholic priest who, during 1663-1666, travelled in Scandinavia. In 1670, he published an account of his travels entitled "Viaggio settentrionale". Negri was born in Ravenna, then part of the Papal States, and left his home city in 1663 to set out on his travels. When the middle-aged priest left his hometown of Ravenna and undertook a three-year voyage in Scandinavia, he became the first.
